architecture: GPT-style decoder-only causal Transformer, pre-LN, tied embeddings, GELU(tanh)
honest_limitations: This is a tiny (0.89M-parameter) demonstration checkpoint trained on a ~19K-token corpus.
It produces mostly word-salad with recognizable learned fragments; it cannot hold conversations, write correct code, or follow instructions reliably (coding parse rate 0.0 in evaluation).
It exists to prove the END-TO-END pipeline is real: from-scratch training -> int8 export -> verified on-device inference with Python/Kotlin numeric parity.
The nexus_500m configuration (507,418,560 parameters) is fully specified and verified by parameter counting; training it needs the GPU compute documented in docs/TRAINING.md.
